results.title: Indian physicist Deepak Dhar wins prestigious 2026 Dirac Medal
results.description: Dhar is one of four physicists to receive this year's medal, the International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP), the Italy-based organisation which issues the award, said in a statement on Saturday

results.title: Three arrested for dangerous bike stunts in Vadapalani
results.description: Three men arrested in Vadapalani for performing dangerous bike stunts and racing at high speeds, endangering public safety.
